_meta.note: IDs, slugs, names and relationships are copied verbatim from the running frontend data layer. Nothing is generated, renamed, merged or invented.
_meta.producedBy: buildMediaGroups() over the media register (src/services/media/mediaGroups.js) + getProductMediaSet() (src/services/media/productMediaSet.js)
_meta.groupingRule: Deterministic filename parsing only: [department]-[category]-[style]-[number]-[view]. Identical base after removing the view suffix = one group. Visual similarity is NEVER an identity input.
_meta.identityRule: Different groupKey = different product. Groups are never merged without an explicit human decision recorded in the productMediaGroups decision register.

decisionRegister.note: The human decision register is empty in the repository — it is written only by operators at runtime.
